newsitem.title: USA: Dow index closes above 8,000 points; Nasdaq soars.
newsitem.headline: Dow index closes above 8,000 points; Nasdaq soars.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average breezed through the 8,000-point milestone Wednesday and the Nasdaq composite index soared nearly 39 points as stocks sizzled on another batch of hot earnings reports and good inflation news.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 63.17 points to close at 8,038.88. The Nasdaq index rose 38.52 points, or 2.50 percent, to 1,580.63, its 10th straight record high.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on heavy volume of 650 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
